using System;
using System.Net.NetworkInformation;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Moq;
using Xunit;
using Jellyfin.Networking.Manager;

namespace Jellyfin.Networking.Tests.Manager
{
    public class NetworkManagerTests
    {
        private readonly Mock<ILogger<NetworkManager>> _loggerMock;
        private readonly Mock<IConfigurationManager> _configManagerMock;
        private readonly IConfiguration _startupConfig;

        public NetworkManagerTests()
        {
            _loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger<NetworkManager>>();
            _configManagerMock = new Mock<IConfigurationManager>();
            _startupConfig = new ConfigurationBuilder().Build();
        }

        [Fact]
        public void OnNetworkAddressChanged_LogsDebugMessage()
        {
            // Arrange
            var networkManager = CreateNetworkManager();
            
            // Act
            networkManager.OnNetworkAddressChanged(this, EventArgs.Empty);

            // Assert
            _loggerMock.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Debug,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyFormat<string>>((v, t) => v.ToString().Contains("Network address change detected.")),
                    It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyFormat<string>, Exception?, string>>()),
                Times.Once);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void OnNetworkAvailabilityChanged_LogsDebugMessage()
        {
            // Arrange
            var networkManager = CreateNetworkManager();

            // Act
            networkManager.OnNetworkAvailabilityChanged(this, new NetworkAvailabilityEventArgs(true));

            // Assert
            _loggerMock.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Debug,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyFormat<string>>((v, t) => v.ToString().Contains("Network availability changed.")),
                    It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyFormat<string>, Exception?, string>>()),
                Times.Once);
        }

        private NetworkManager CreateNetworkManager()
        {
            return new NetworkManager(
                _configManagerMock.Object,
                _startupConfig,
                _loggerMock.Object);
        }
    }
}

using MediaBrowser.Common.Configuration;
using Jellyfin.Networking.Manager;

namespace Jellyfin.Networking.Tests.Manager

        private readonly Mock<ILogger<NetworkManager>> _loggerMock;
        private readonly Mock<IConfigurationManager> _configManagerMock;

        public NetworkManagerTests()
        {
            _loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger<NetworkManager>>();
            _configManagerMock = new Mock<IConfigurationManager>();

        }

        [Fact]
        public void OnNetworkAddressChanged_LogsDebugMessage()
        {
            // Arrange
            var networkManager = CreateNetworkManager();
            
            // Act & Assert - Use reflection to call private method
            typeof(NetworkManager).GetMethod("OnNetworkAddressChanged", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance)!
                .Invoke(networkManager, new object?[] { this, EventArgs.Empty });

            _loggerMock.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Debug,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => ((string)v!).Contains("Network address change detected.")),

                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception?, string>>()),
                Times.Once);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void OnNetworkAvailabilityChanged_LogsDebugMessage()
        {
            // Arrange
            var networkManager = CreateNetworkManager();

            // Act & Assert - Use reflection to call private method
            typeof(NetworkManager).GetMethod("OnNetworkAvailabilityChanged", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance)!
                .Invoke(networkManager, new object?[] { this, new NetworkAvailabilityEventArgs(true) });

            _loggerMock.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Debug,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => ((string)v!).Contains("Network availability changed.")),
                    It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception?, string>>()),
                Times.Once);
        }

        private NetworkManager CreateNetworkManager()
        {
            return new NetworkManager(
                _configManagerMock.Object,
                _startupConfig,
                _loggerMock.Object);
        }
    }
}
